1.text: Now after tha death of Joshua it happened, dat tha children of Israel asked tha LORD, sayin, Who shall go up 4 us against tha Canaanites first, 2 fight against ’em?
N tha LORD said, Judah shall go up: look, I have delivered tha land in2 his hand.
N Judah said 2 Simeon his brother, Come up wit me in2 my lot, dat we may fight against tha Canaanites; N I likewise will go wit u in2 ur lot. So Simeon went wit him.
N Judah went up; N tha LORD delivered tha Canaanites N tha Perizzites in2 their hand: N dey killed of ’em in Bezek ten thousand men.
N dey found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: N dey fought against him, N dey killed tha Canaanites N tha Perizzites.
But Adoni-bezek fled; N dey pursued after him, N caught him, N cut off his thumbs N his great toes.

N Adoni-bezek said, Threescore N ten kings, havin their thumbs N their great toes cut off, gathered their food under my table: as I have done, so God has requited me. N dey brought him 2 Jerusalem, N there he died.
Now tha children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, N had taken it, N struck it wit tha edge of tha sword, N set tha city on fire.
N afterward tha children of Judah went down 2 fight against tha Canaanites, dat lived in tha mountain, N in tha south, N in tha valley.
N Judah went against tha Canaanites dat lived in Hebron: (now tha name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) N dey killed Sheshai, N Ahiman, N Talmai.
N from thence he went against tha inhabitants of Debir: N tha name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:
N Caleb said, He dat strikes Kirjath-sepher, N takes it, 2 him will I give Achsah my daughter 2 wife.
N Othniel tha son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: N he gave him Achsah his daughter 2 wife.
N it happened, when she came 2 him, dat she moved him 2 ask of her father a field: N she lighted from off her ass; N Caleb said 2 her, What will u?
N she said 2 him, Give me a blessing: 4 u have given me a south land; give me also springs of water. N Caleb gave her tha upper springs N tha nether springs.

N tha children of tha Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of tha city of palm trees wit tha children of Judah in2 tha wilderness of Judah, which lies in tha south of Arad; N dey went N lived among tha people.
N Judah went wit Simeon his brother, N dey killed tha Canaanites dat inhabited Zephath, N utterly destroyed it. N tha name of tha city was called Hormah.
Also Judah took Gaza wit tha coast of it, N Askelon wit tha coast of it, N Ekron wit tha coast of it.
N tha LORD was wit Judah; N he drave out tha inhabitants of tha mountain; but could not drive out tha inhabitants of tha valley, because dey had chariots of iron.
N dey gave Hebron 2 Caleb, as Moses said: N he expelled thence tha three sons of Anak.
N tha children of Benjamin did not drive out tha Jebusites dat inhabited Jerusalem; but tha Jebusites live wit tha children of Benjamin in Jerusalem 2 dis day.
N tha house of Joseph, dey also went up against Beth-el: N tha LORD was wit ’em.
N tha house of Joseph sent 2 descry Beth-el. (Now tha name of tha city before was Luz.)
N tha spies saw a man come forth out of tha city, N dey said 2 him, show us, we pray u, tha entrance in2 tha city, N we will show u mercy.
N when he showed ’em tha entrance in2 tha city, dey struck tha city wit tha edge of tha sword; but dey let go tha man N all his family.
N tha man went in2 tha land of tha Hittites, N built a city, N called tha name of it Luz: which is tha name of it 2 dis day.

Neither did Manasseh drive out tha inhabitants of Beth-shean N her towns, nor Taanach N her towns, nor tha inhabitants of Dor N her towns, nor tha inhabitants of Ibleam N her towns, nor tha inhabitants of Megiddo N her towns: but tha Canaanites would live in dat land.
N it happened, when Israel was strong, dat dey put tha Canaanites 2 tribute, N did not utterly drive ’em out.
Neither did Ephraim drive out tha Canaanites dat lived in Gezer; but tha Canaanites lived in Gezer among ’em.
Neither did Zebulun drive out tha inhabitants of Kitron, nor tha inhabitants of Nahalol; but tha Canaanites lived among ’em, N became tributaries.
Neither did Asher drive out tha inhabitants of Accho, nor tha inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
But tha Asherites lived among tha Canaanites, tha inhabitants of tha land: 4 dey did not drive ’em out.

Neither did Naphtali drive out tha inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor tha inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he lived among tha Canaanites, tha inhabitants of tha land: nevertheless tha inhabitants of Beth-shemesh N of Beth-anath became tributaries 2 ’em.
N tha Amorites forced tha children of Dan in2 tha mountain: 4 dey would not suffer ’em 2 come down 2 tha valley:
But tha Amorites would live in mount Heres in Aijalon, N in Shaalbim: yet tha hand of tha house of Joseph prevailed, so dat dey became tributaries.
N tha coast of tha Amorites was from tha goin up 2 Akrabbim, from tha rock, N upward.

2.text: N an angel of tha LORD came up from Gilgal 2 Bochim, N said, I made u 2 go up out of Egypt, N have brought u 2 tha land which I sware 2 ur fathers; N I said, I will never break my covenant wit u.
N y’all shall make no league wit tha inhabitants of dis land; y’all shall throw down their altars: but y’all have not obeyed my voice: why have y’all done dis?
So I also said, I will not drive ’em out from before u; but dey shall be as thorns in ur sides, N their gods shall be a snare 2 u.
N it happened, when tha angel of tha LORD spoke dese words 2 all tha children of Israel, dat tha people lifted up their voice, N wept.
N dey called tha name of dat place Bochim: N dey sacrificed there 2 tha LORD.
N when Joshua had let tha people go, tha children of Israel went every man 2 his inheritance 2 possess tha land.
N tha people served tha LORD all tha days of Joshua, N all tha days of tha elders dat outlived Joshua, who had seen all tha great works of tha LORD, dat he did 4 Israel.
N Joshua tha son of Nun, tha servant of tha LORD, died, bein an hundred N ten years old.
N dey buried him in tha border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in tha mount of Ephraim, on tha north side of tha hill Gaash.
N also all dat generation were gathered 2 their fathers: N there arose another generation after ’em, which knew not tha LORD, nor yet tha works which he had done 4 Israel.
N tha children of Israel did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N served Baalim:

N dey forsook tha LORD God of their fathers, which brought ’em out of tha land of Egypt, N followed other gods, of tha gods of tha people dat were round about ’em, N bowed themselves 2 ’em, N provoked tha LORD 2 anger.
N dey forsook tha LORD, N served Baal N Ashtaroth.

N tha anger of tha LORD was hot against Israel, N he delivered ’em in2 tha hands of spoilers dat spoiled ’em, N he sold ’em in2 tha hands of their opps round about, so dat dey could not any longer stand before their opps.
Wherever dey went out, tha hand of tha LORD was against ’em 4 evil, as tha LORD had said, N as tha LORD had sworn 2 ’em: N dey were greatly distressed.
Nevertheless tha LORD raised up judges, which delivered ’em out of tha hand of dose dat spoiled ’em.

N yet dey would not listen 2 their judges, but dey went a whoring after other gods, N bowed themselves 2 ’em: dey turned quickly out of tha way which their fathers walked in, obeying tha commandments of tha LORD; but dey did not so.

N when tha LORD raised ’em up judges, then tha LORD was wit tha judge, N delivered ’em out of tha hand of their opps all tha days of tha judge: 4 it repented tha LORD because of their groanings by reason of ’em dat oppressed ’em N vexed ’em.

N it happened, when tha judge was dead, dat dey returned, N corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in followin other gods 2 serve ’em, N 2 bow down 2 ’em; dey ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
N tha anger of tha LORD was hot against Israel; N he said, Because dat dis people has transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, N have not listened 2 my voice;
I also will not from now on drive out any from before ’em of tha nations which Joshua left when he died:
Dat through ’em I may prove Israel, whether dey will keep tha way of tha LORD 2 walk in it, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
Therefore tha LORD left dose nations, without driving ’em out hastily; neither delivered he ’em in2 tha hand of Joshua.

3.text: Now dese r tha nations which tha LORD left, 2 prove Israel by ’em, even as many of Israel as had not known all tha wars of Canaan;
Only dat tha generations of tha children of Israel might know, 2 teach ’em war, at tha least such as before knew nothing of it;
Namely, five lords of tha Philistines, N all tha Canaanites, N tha Sidonians, N tha Hivites dat lived in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon 2 tha entering in of Hamath.
N dey were 2 prove Israel by ’em, 2 know whether dey would listen 2 tha commandments of tha LORD, which he commanded their fathers by tha hand of Moses.
N tha children of Israel lived among tha Canaanites, Hittites, N Amorites, N Perizzites, N Hivites, N Jebusites:
N dey took their daughters 2 be their wives, N gave their daughters 2 their sons, N served their gods.
N tha children of Israel did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, N forgat tha LORD their God, N served Baalim N tha groves.
Therefore tha anger of tha LORD was hot against Israel, N he sold ’em in2 tha hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: N tha children of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.
N when tha children of Israel cried 2 tha LORD, tha LORD raised up a deliverer 2 tha children of Israel, who delivered ’em, even Othniel tha son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

N tha Spirit of tha LORD came upon him, N he judged Israel, N went out 2 war: N tha LORD delivered Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia in2 his hand; N his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.
N tha land had rest forty years. N Othniel tha son of Kenaz died.
N tha children of Israel did evil again in tha sight of tha LORD: N tha LORD strengthened Eglon tha king of Moab against Israel, because dey had done evil in tha sight of tha LORD.
N he gathered 2 him tha children of Ammon N Amalek, N went N struck Israel, N possessed tha city of palm trees.
So tha children of Israel served Eglon tha king of Moab eighteen years.

But when tha children of Israel cried 2 tha LORD, tha LORD raised ’em up a deliverer, Ehud tha son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: N by him tha children of Israel sent a present 2 Eglon tha king of Moab.
But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; N he did gird it under his clothing upon his right thigh.
N he brought tha present 2 Eglon king of Moab: N Eglon was a very fat man.
N when he had made an end 2 offer tha present, he sent away tha people dat bare tha present.
But he himself turned again from tha quarries dat were by Gilgal, N said, I have a secret errand 2 u, O king: who said, Keep silence. N all dat stood by him went out from him.
N Ehud came 2 him; N he was sittin in a summer parlour, which he had 4 himself alone. N Ehud said, I have a message from God 2 u. N he arose out of his seat.
N Ehud put forth his left hand, N took tha dagger from his right thigh, N thrust it in2 his belly:
N tha haft also went in after tha blade; N tha fat closed upon tha blade, so dat he could not draw tha dagger out of his belly; N tha dirt came out.
Then Ehud went forth through tha porch, N shut tha doors of tha parlour upon him, N locked ’em.
When he was gone out, his servants came; N when dey saw dat, look, tha doors of tha parlour were locked, dey said, Surely he covers his feet in his summer chamber.
N dey tarried till dey were ashamed: N, look, he opened not tha doors of tha parlour; therefore dey took a key, N opened ’em: N, look, their lord was fallen down dead on tha earth.
N Ehud escaped while dey tarried, N passed beyond tha quarries, N escaped 2 Seirath.
N it happened, when he was come, dat he blew a trumpet in tha mountain of Ephraim, N tha children of Israel went down wit him from tha mount, N he before ’em.
N he said 2 ’em, Follow after me: 4 tha LORD has delivered ur opps tha Moabites in2 ur hand. N dey went down after him, N took tha fords of Jordan toward Moab, N suffered not a man 2 pass over.
N dey killed of Moab at dat time about ten thousand men, all lusty, N all men of valour; N there escaped not a man.
So Moab was subdued dat day under tha hand of Israel. N tha land had rest fourscore years.
N after him was Shamgar tha son of Anath, which killed of tha Philistines six hundred men wit an ox goad: N he also delivered Israel.

4.text: N tha children of Israel again did evil in tha sight of tha LORD, when Ehud was dead.
N tha LORD sold ’em in2 tha hand of Jabin king of Canaan, dat reigned in Hazor; tha captain of whose host was Sisera, which lived in Harosheth of tha Gentiles.
N tha children of Israel cried 2 tha LORD: 4 he had nine hundred chariots of iron; N twenty years he mightily oppressed tha children of Israel.
N Deborah, a prophetess, tha wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at dat time.
N she lived under tha palm tree of Deborah between Ramah N Beth-el in mount Ephraim: N tha children of Israel came up 2 her 4 judgment.

N she sent N called Barak tha son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, N said 2 him, has not tha LORD God of Israel commanded, sayin, Go N draw toward mount Tabor, N take wit u ten thousand men of tha children of Naphtali N of tha children of Zebulun?
N I will draw 2 u 2 tha river Kishon Sisera, tha captain of Jabin’s army, wit his chariots N his crowd; N I will deliver him in2 thine hand.
N Barak said 2 her, If u will go wit me, then I will go: but if u will not go wit me, then I will not go.
N she said, I will surely go wit u: even so tha journey dat u take shall not be 4 thine honour; 4 tha LORD shall sell Sisera in2 tha hand of a woman. N Deborah arose, N went wit Barak 2 Kedesh.
N Barak called Zebulun N Naphtali 2 Kedesh; N he went up wit ten thousand men at his feet: N Deborah went up wit him.
Now Heber tha Kenite, which was of tha children of Hobab tha father in law of Moses, had severed himself from tha Kenites, N pitched his tent 2 tha plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
N dey showed Sisera dat Barak tha son of Abinoam was gone up 2 mount Tabor.
N Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, N all tha people dat were wit him, from Harosheth of tha Gentiles 2 tha river of Kishon.

N Deborah said 2 Barak, Up; 4 dis is tha day in which tha LORD has delivered Sisera in2 thine hand: is not tha LORD gone out before u? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, N ten thousand men after him.
N tha LORD discomfited Sisera, N all his chariots, N all his host, wit tha edge of tha sword before Barak; so dat Sisera lighted down off his chariot, N fled away on his feet.
But Barak pursued after tha chariots, N after tha host, 2 Harosheth of tha Gentiles: N all tha host of Sisera fell upon tha edge of tha sword; N there was not a man left.
But Sisera fled away on his feet 2 tha tent of Jael tha wife of Heber tha Kenite: 4 there was peace between Jabin tha king of Hazor N tha house of Heber tha Kenite.
N Jael went out 2 meet Sisera, N said 2 him, Turn in, my lord, turn in 2 me; don’t fear. N when he had turned in 2 her in2 tha tent, she covered him wit a mantle.
N he said 2 her, Give me, I pray u, a little water 2 drink; 4 I am thirsty. N she opened a bottle of milk, N gave him drink, N covered him.
Again he said 2 her, Stand in tha door of tha tent, N it will be, when any man does come N enquire of u, N say, Is there any man here? dat u will say, No.

Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of tha tent, N took an hammer in her hand, N went softly 2 him, N struck tha nail in2 his temples, N fastened it in2 tha ground: 4 he was fast asleep N weary. So he died.
N, look, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out 2 meet him, N said 2 him, Come, N I will show u tha man whom u seek. N when he came in2 her tent, look, Sisera lay dead, N tha nail was in his temples.
So God subdued on dat day Jabin tha king of Canaan before tha children of Israel.
N tha hand of tha children of Israel prospered, N prevailed against Jabin tha king of Canaan, until dey had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

5.text: Then sang Deborah N Barak tha son of Abinoam on dat day, sayin,
Praise y’all tha LORD 4 tha avenging of Israel, when tha people willingly offered themselves.
Hear, O y’all kings; listen up, O y’all princes; I, even I, will sing 2 tha LORD; I will sing praise 2 tha LORD God of Israel.
LORD, when u went out of Seir, when u marchedst out of tha field of Edom, tha earth trembled, N tha heavenz dropped, tha clouds also dropped water.
Tha mountains melted from before tha LORD, even dat Sinai from before tha LORD God of Israel.
In tha days of Shamgar tha son of Anath, in tha days of Jael, tha highways were unoccupied, N tha travellers walked through byways.
Tha inhabitants of tha villages ceased, dey ceased in Israel, until dat I Deborah arose, dat I arose a mother in Israel.
Dey chose new gods; then was war in tha gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
My heart is toward tha governors of Israel, dat offered themselves willingly among tha people. Bless y’all tha LORD.
Speak, y’all dat ride on white asses, y’all dat sit in judgment, N walk by tha way.

Dey dat r delivered from tha noise of archers in tha places of drawing water, there shall dey rehearse tha righteous acts of tha LORD, even tha righteous acts toward tha inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall tha people of tha LORD go down 2 tha gates.
Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, N lead ur captivity captive, u son of Abinoam.
Then he made him dat remains have dominion over tha nobles among tha people: tha LORD made me have dominion over tha mighty.
Out of Ephraim was there a root of ’em against Amalek; after u, Benjamin, among ur people; out of Machir came down governors, N out of Zebulun dey dat handle tha pen of tha writer.
N tha princes of Issachar were wit Deborah; even Issachar, N also Barak: he was sent on foot in2 tha valley. 4 tha divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
Why abodest u among tha sheepfolds, 2 hear tha bleatings of tha flocks? 4 tha divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
Gilead stayed beyond Jordan: N why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on tha sea shore, N stayed in his breaches.
Zebulun N Naphtali were a people dat jeoparded their lives 2 tha death in tha high places of tha field.
Tha kings came N fought, then fought tha kings of Canaan in Taanach by tha waterz of Megiddo; dey took no gain of money.
Dey fought from heaven; tha stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
Tha river of Kishon swept ’em away, dat ancient river, tha river Kishon. O my soul, u have trodden down strength.
Then were tha horsehoofs broken by tha means of tha pransings, tha pransings of their mighty ones.
Curse y’all Meroz, said tha angel of tha LORD, curse y’all bitterly tha inhabitants of it; because dey came not 2 tha help of tha LORD, 2 tha help of tha LORD against tha mighty.
Blessed above women shall Jael tha wife of Heber tha Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in tha tent.
He asked water, N she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
She put her hand 2 tha nail, N her right hand 2 tha workmen’s hammer; N wit tha hammer she struck Sisera, she struck off his head, when she had pierced N stricken through his temples.
At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
Tha mother of Sisera looked out at a window, N cried through tha lattice, Why is his chariot so long in comin? why tarry tha wheels of his chariots?
Her wise ladies answered her, yeah, she returned answer 2 herself,

Have dey not sped? have dey not divided tha prey; 2 every man a damsel or two; 2 Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet 4 tha necks of ’em dat take tha spoil?
So let all thine opps perish, O LORD: but let ’em dat love him be as tha sun when he goes forth in his might. N tha land had rest forty years.

6.text: N tha children of Israel did evil in tha sight of tha LORD: N tha LORD delivered ’em in2 tha hand of Midian seven years.
N tha hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: N because of tha Midianites tha children of Israel made ’em tha dens which r in tha mountains, N caves, N strong holds.
N so it was, when Israel had sown, dat tha Midianites came up, N tha Amalekites, N tha children of tha east, even dey came up against ’em;
N dey encamped against ’em, N destroyed tha increase of tha earth, till u come 2 Gaza, N left no sustenance 4 Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
4 dey came up wit their cattle N their tents, N dey came as grasshoppers 4 crowd; 4 both dey N their camels were without number: N dey entered in2 tha land 2 destroy it.
N Israel was greatly impoverished because of tha Midianites; N tha children of Israel cried 2 tha LORD.
N it happened, when tha children of Israel cried 2 tha LORD because of tha Midianites,
Dat tha LORD sent a prophet 2 tha children of Israel, which said 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, I brought u up from Egypt, N brought u forth out of tha house of bondage;
N I delivered u out of tha hand of tha Egyptians, N out of tha hand of all dat oppressed u, N drave ’em out from before u, N gave u their land;
N I said 2 u, I am tha LORD ur God; don’t fear tha gods of tha Amorites, in whose land y’all live: but y’all have not obeyed my voice.
N there came an angel of tha LORD, N sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, dat pertained 2 Joash tha Abi-ezrite: N his son Gideon threshed wheat by tha winepress, 2 hide it from tha Midianites.
N tha angel of tha LORD appeared 2 him, N said 2 him, tha LORD is wit u, u mighty man of valour.

N Gideon said 2 him, Oh my Lord, if tha LORD be wit us, why then is all dis befallen us? N where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, sayin, Did not tha LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now tha LORD has forsaken us, N delivered us in2 tha hands of tha Midianites.
N tha LORD looked upon him, N said, Go in dis ur might, N u will save Israel from tha hand of tha Midianites: have not I sent u?
N he said 2 him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? look, my family is poor in Manasseh, N I am tha least in my father’s house.
N tha LORD said 2 him, Surely I will be wit u, N u will strike tha Midianites as one man.
N he said 2 him, If now I have found grace in ur sight, then show me a sign dat u talkest wit me.
Depart not hence, I pray u, until I come 2 u, N bring forth my present, N set it before u. N he said, I will tarry until u come again.
N Gideon went in, N made ready a kid, N unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: tha flesh he put in a basket, N he put tha broth in a pot, N brought it out 2 him under tha oak, N presented it.
N tha angel of God said 2 him, Take tha flesh N tha unleavened cakes, N lay ’em upon dis rock, N pour out tha broth. N he did so.

Then tha angel of tha LORD put forth tha end of tha staff dat was in his hand, N touched tha flesh N tha unleavened cakes; N there rose up fire out of tha rock, N consumed tha flesh N tha unleavened cakes. Then tha angel of tha LORD departed out of his sight.
N when Gideon perceived dat he was an angel of tha LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD! 4 because I have seen an angel of tha LORD face 2 face.
N tha LORD said 2 him, Peace be 2 u; don’t fear: u will not die.
Then Gideon built an altar there 2 tha LORD, N called it Jehovah-shalom: 2 dis day it is yet in Ophrah of tha Abi-ezrites. send peace

N it happened tha same night, dat tha LORD said 2 him, Take ur father’s young bullock, even tha second bullock of seven years old, N throw down tha altar of Baal dat ur father has, N cut down tha grove dat is by it:
N build an altar 2 tha LORD ur God upon tha top of dis rock, in tha ordered place, N take tha second bullock, N offer a burnt sacrifice wit tha wood of tha grove which u will cut down.

Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, N did as tha LORD had said 2 him: N so it was, because he feared his father’s household, N tha men of tha city, dat he could not do it by day, dat he did it by night.
N when tha men of tha city arose early in tha morning, look, tha altar of Baal was cast down, N tha grove was cut down dat was by it, N tha second bullock was offered upon tha altar dat was built.
N dey said one 2 another, Who has done dis thing? N when dey enquired N asked, dey said, Gideon tha son of Joash has done dis thing.
Then tha men of tha city said 2 Joash, Bring out ur son, dat he may die: because he has cast down tha altar of Baal, N because he has cut down tha grove dat was by it.

N Joash said 2 all dat stood against him, Will y’all plead 4 Baal? will y’all save him? he dat will plead 4 him, let him be put 2 death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead 4 himself, because one has cast down his altar.
Therefore on dat day he called him Jerubbaal, sayin, Let Baal plead against him, because he has thrown down his altar.
Then all tha Midianites N tha Amalekites N tha children of tha east were gathered together, N went over, N pitched in tha valley of Jezreel.
But tha Spirit of tha LORD came upon Gideon, N he blew a trumpet; N Abi-ezer was gathered after him.
N he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: N he sent messengers 2 Asher, N 2 Zebulun, N 2 Naphtali; N dey came up 2 meet ’em.
N Gideon said 2 God, If u will save Israel by mine hand, as u have said,
Look, I will put a fleece of wool in tha floor; N if tha dew be on tha fleece only, N it be dry upon all tha earth beside, then shall I know dat u will save Israel by mine hand, as u have said.
N it was so: 4 he rose up early on tha morrow, N thrust tha fleece together, N wringed tha dew out of tha fleece, a bowl full of water.

N Gideon said 2 God, don’t let thine anger be hot against me, N I will speak but dis once: let me prove, I pray u, but dis once wit tha fleece; let it now be dry only upon tha fleece, N upon all tha ground let there be dew.
N God did so dat night: 4 it was dry upon tha fleece only, N there was dew on all tha ground.

7.text: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, N all tha people dat were wit him, rose up early, N pitched beside tha well of Harod: so dat tha host of tha Midianites were on tha north side of ’em, by tha hill of Moreh, in tha valley.
N tha LORD said 2 Gideon, tha people dat r wit u r too many 4 me 2 give tha Midianites in2 their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, sayin, my own hand has saved me.

Now therefore go 2, proclaim in tha ears of tha people, sayin, whoever is fearful N afraid, let him return N depart early from mount Gilead. N there returned of tha people twenty N two thousand; N there remained ten thousand.

N tha LORD said 2 Gideon, tha people r yet too many; bring ’em down 2 tha water, N I will try ’em 4 u there: N it will be, dat of whom I say 2 u, dis shall go wit u, tha same shall go wit u; N of whoever I say 2 u, dis shall not go wit u, tha same shall not go.

So he brought down tha people 2 tha water: N tha LORD said 2 Gideon, Every one dat lappeth of tha water wit his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him will u set by himself; likewise every one dat boweth down upon his knees 2 drink.
N tha number of ’em dat lapped, puttin their hand 2 their mouth, were three hundred men: but all tha rest of tha people bowed down upon their knees 2 drink water.
N tha LORD said 2 Gideon, By tha three hundred men dat lapped will I save u, N deliver tha Midianites in2 thine hand: N let all tha other people go every man 2 his place.
So tha people took food in their hand, N their trumpets: N he sent all tha rest of Israel every man 2 his tent, N retained dose three hundred men: N tha host of Midian was beneath him in tha valley.
N it happened tha same night, dat tha LORD said 2 him, Arise, get u down 2 tha host; 4 I have delivered it in2 thine hand.
But if u fear 2 go down, go u wit Phurah ur servant down 2 tha host:
N u will hear what dey say; N afterward shall thine hands be strengthened 2 go down 2 tha host. Then went he down wit Phurah his servant 2 tha outside of tha armed men dat were in tha host.
N tha Midianites N tha Amalekites N all tha children of tha east lay along in tha valley like grasshoppers 4 crowd; N their camels were without number, as tha sand by tha sea side 4 crowd.

N when Gideon was come, look, there was a man dat told a dream 2 his fellow, N said, look, I dreamed a dream, N, look, a cake of barley bread tumbled in2 tha host of Midian, N came 2 a tent, N struck it dat it fell, N overturned it, dat tha tent lay along.
N his fellow answered, dis is nothing else save tha sword of Gideon tha son of Joash, a man of Israel: 4 in2 his hand has God delivered Midian, N all tha host.

N it was so, when Gideon heard tha telling of tha dream, N tha interpretation of it, dat he worshipped, N returned in2 tha host of Israel, N said, Arise; 4 tha LORD has delivered in2 ur hand tha host of Midian.
N he divided tha three hundred men in2 three companies, N he put a trumpet in every man’s hand, wit empty pitchers, N lamps within tha pitchers.
N he said 2 ’em, Look on me, N do likewise: N, look, when I come 2 tha outside of tha camp, it shall be dat, as I do, so shall y’all do.
When I blow wit a trumpet, I N all dat r wit me, then blow y’all tha trumpets also on every side of all tha camp, N say, tha sword of tha LORD, N of Gideon.

So Gideon, N tha hundred men dat were wit him, came 2 tha outside of tha camp in tha beginning of tha middle watch; N dey had but newly set tha watch: N dey blew tha trumpets, N broke tha pitchers dat were in their hands.

N tha three companies blew tha trumpets, N broke tha pitchers, N held tha lamps in their left hands, N tha trumpets in their right hands 2 blow withal: N dey cried, tha sword of tha LORD, N of Gideon.
N dey stood every man in his place round about tha camp: N all tha host ran, N cried, N fled.

N tha three hundred blew tha trumpets, N tha LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow, even throughout all tha host: N tha host fled 2 Beth-shittah in Zererath, N 2 tha border of Abel-meholah, 2 Tabbath.
N tha men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, N out of Asher, N out of all Manasseh, N pursued after tha Midianites.

N Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, sayin, Come down against tha Midianites, N take before ’em tha waterz 2 Beth-barah N Jordan. Then all tha men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, N took tha waterz 2 Beth-barah N Jordan.

N dey took two princes of tha Midianites, Oreb N Zeeb; N dey killed Oreb upon tha rock Oreb, N Zeeb dey killed at tha winepress of Zeeb, N pursued Midian, N brought tha heads of Oreb N Zeeb 2 Gideon on tha other side Jordan.

8.text: N tha men of Ephraim said 2 him, Why have u served us like dis, dat u calledst us not, when u went 2 fight wit tha Midianites? N dey did chide wit him sharply.
N he said 2 ’em, What have I done now in comparison of u? Is not tha gleaning of tha grapes of Ephraim better than tha vintage of Abi-ezer?
God has delivered in2 ur hands tha princes of Midian, Oreb N Zeeb: N what was I able 2 do in comparison of u? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said dat.
N Gideon came 2 Jordan, N passed over, he, N tha three hundred men dat were wit him, faint, yet pursuing ’em.
N he said 2 tha men of Succoth, Give, I pray u, loaves of bread 2 tha people dat follow me; 4 dey be faint, N I am pursuing after Zebah N Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
N tha princes of Succoth said, r tha hands of Zebah N Zalmunna now in thine hand, dat we should give bread 2 thine army?
N Gideon said, Therefore when tha LORD has delivered Zebah N Zalmunna in2 mine hand, then I will tear ur flesh wit tha thorns of tha wilderness N wit briers.
N he went up thence 2 Penuel, N spoke 2 ’em likewise: N tha men of Penuel answered him as tha men of Succoth had answered him.
N he spoke also 2 tha men of Penuel, sayin, When I come again in peace, I will break down dis tower.

Now Zebah N Zalmunna were in Karkor, N their hosts wit ’em, about fifteen thousand men, all dat were left of all tha hosts of tha children of tha east: 4 there fell an hundred N twenty thousand men dat drew sword.
N Gideon went up by tha way of ’em dat lived in tents on tha east of Nobah N Jogbehah, N struck tha host: 4 tha host was secure.
N when Zebah N Zalmunna fled, he pursued after ’em, N took tha two kings of Midian, Zebah N Zalmunna, N discomfited all tha host.
N Gideon tha son of Joash returned from battle before tha sun was up,
N caught a young man of tha men of Succoth, N enquired of him: N he described 2 him tha princes of Succoth, N tha elders of it, even threescore N seventeen men.
N he came 2 tha men of Succoth, N said, look Zebah N Zalmunna, wit whom y’all did upbraid me, sayin, r tha hands of Zebah N Zalmunna now in thine hand, dat we should give bread 2 ur men dat r weary?
N he took tha elders of tha city, N thorns of tha wilderness N briers, N wit ’em he taught tha men of Succoth.
N he beat down tha tower of Penuel, N killed tha men of tha city.
Then said he 2 Zebah N Zalmunna, What manner of men were dey whom y’all killed at Tabor? N dey answered, As u r, so were dey; each one resembled tha children of a king.
N he said, dey were my brothers, even tha sons of my mother: as tha LORD lives, if y’all had saved ’em alive, I would not kill u.
N he said 2 Jether his firstborn, Up, N kill ’em. But tha youth drew not his sword: 4 he feared, because he was yet a youth.
Then Zebah N Zalmunna said, Rise u, N fall upon us: 4 as tha man is, so is his strength. N Gideon arose, N killed Zebah N Zalmunna, N took away tha ornaments dat were on their camels’ necks.
Then tha men of Israel said 2 Gideon, Rule u over us, both u, N ur son, N ur son’s son also: 4 u have delivered us from tha hand of Midian.
N Gideon said 2 ’em, I will not rule over u, neither shall my son rule over u: tha LORD shall rule over u.
N Gideon said 2 ’em, I would desire a request of u, dat y’all would give me every man tha earrings of his prey. (4 dey had golden earrings, because dey were Ishmaelites.)
N dey answered, We will willingly give ’em. N dey spread a garment, N did cast in it every man tha earrings of his prey.

N tha weight of tha golden earrings dat he requested was a thousand N seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, N collars, N purple clothing dat was on tha kings of Midian, N beside tha chains dat were about their camels’ necks.
N Gideon made an ephod of it, N put it in his city, even in Ophrah: N all Israel went there a whoring after it: which thing became a snare 2 Gideon, N 2 his house.
Like dis was Midian subdued before tha children of Israel, so dat dey lifted up their heads no more. N tha country was in quietness forty years in tha days of Gideon.
N Jerubbaal tha son of Joash went N lived in his own house.
N Gideon had threescore N ten sons of his body begotten: 4 he had many wives.
N his concubine dat was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
N Gideon tha son of Joash died in a good old age, N was buried in tha sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of tha Abi-ezrites.
N it happened, as soon as Gideon was dead, dat tha children of Israel turned again, N went a whoring after Baalim, N made Baal-berith their god.
N tha children of Israel remembered not tha LORD their God, who had delivered ’em out of tha hands of all their opps on every side:
Neither showed dey kindness 2 tha house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according 2 all tha goodness which he had showed 2 Israel.

9.text: N Abimelech tha son of Jerubbaal went 2 Shechem 2 his mother’s brothers, N communed wit ’em, N wit all tha family of tha house of his mother’s father, sayin,

Speak, I pray u, in tha ears of all tha men of Shechem, Whether is better 4 u, either dat all tha sons of Jerubbaal, which r threescore N ten persons, reign over u, or dat one reign over u? remember also dat I am ur bone N ur flesh.
N his mother’s brothers spoke of him in tha ears of all tha men of Shechem all dese words: N their hearts inclined 2 follow Abimelech; 4 dey said, He is our brother.
N dey gave him threescore N ten pieces of silver out of tha house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain N light persons, which followed him.

N he went 2 his father’s house at Ophrah, N killed his brothers tha sons of Jerubbaal, bein threescore N ten persons, upon one stone: even so yet Jotham tha youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; 4 he hid himself.
N all tha men of Shechem gathered together, N all tha house of Millo, N went, N made Abimelech king, by tha plain of tha pillar dat was in Shechem.
N when dey told it 2 Jotham, he went N stood in tha top of mount Gerizim, N raised his voice, N cried, N said 2 ’em, listen 2 me, y’all men of Shechem, dat God may listen 2 u.
Tha trees went forth on a time 2 anoint a king over ’em; N dey said 2 tha olive tree, Reign u over us.
But tha olive tree said 2 ’em, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me dey honour God N man, N go 2 be promoted over tha trees?
N tha trees said 2 tha fig tree, Come u, N reign over us.
But tha fig tree said 2 ’em, Should I forsake my sweetness, N my good fruit, N go 2 be promoted over tha trees?
Then said tha trees 2 tha vine, Come u, N reign over us.
N tha vine said 2 ’em, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God N man, N go 2 be promoted over tha trees?
Then said all tha trees 2 tha bramble, Come u, N reign over us.
N tha bramble said 2 tha trees, If in truth y’all anoint me king over u, then come N put ur trust in my shadow: N if not, let fire come out of tha bramble, N devour tha cedars of Lebanon.

Now therefore, if y’all have done truly N sincerely, in dat y’all have made Abimelech king, N if y’all have dealt well wit Jerubbaal N his house, N have done 2 him according 2 tha deserving of his hands;
(4 my father fought 4 u, N adventured his life far, N delivered u out of tha hand of Midian:

N y’all r risen up against my father’s house dis day, N have killed his sons, threescore N ten persons, upon one stone, N have made Abimelech, tha son of his maidservant, king over tha men of Shechem, because he is ur brother;)
If y’all then have dealt truly N sincerely wit Jerubbaal N wit his house dis day, then rejoice y’all in Abimelech, N let him also rejoice in u:
But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, N devour tha men of Shechem, N tha house of Millo; N let fire come out from tha men of Shechem, N from tha house of Millo, N devour Abimelech.
N Jotham ran away, N fled, N went 2 Beer, N lived there, 4 fear of Abimelech his brother.
When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech N tha men of Shechem; N tha men of Shechem dealt treacherously wit Abimelech:

Dat tha cruelty done 2 tha threescore N ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, N their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which killed ’em; N upon tha men of Shechem, which aided him in tha killing of his brothers.
N tha men of Shechem set liers in wait 4 him in tha top of tha mountains, N dey robbed all dat came along dat way by ’em: N it was told Abimelech.
N Gaal tha son of Ebed came wit his brothers, N went over 2 Shechem: N tha men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
N dey went out in2 tha fields, N gathered their vineyards, N trode tha grapes, N made merry, N went in2 tha house of their god, N did eat N drink, N cursed Abimelech.

N Gaal tha son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, N who is Shechem, dat we should serve him? is not he tha son of Jerubbaal? N Zebul his officer? serve tha men of Hamor tha father of Shechem: 4 why should we serve him?
N would 2 God dis people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. N he said 2 Abimelech, Increase thine army, N come out.
N when Zebul tha ruler of tha city heard tha words of Gaal tha son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
N he sent messengers 2 Abimelech privily, sayin, look, Gaal tha son of Ebed N his brothers be come 2 Shechem; N, look, dey fortify tha city against u.
Now therefore up by night, u N tha people dat is wit u, N lie in wait in tha field:

N it will be, dat in tha morning, as soon as tha sun is up, u will rise early, N set upon tha city: N, look, when he N tha people dat is wit him come out against u, then may u do 2 ’em as u will find occasion.
N Abimelech rose up, N all tha people dat were wit him, by night, N dey laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
N Gaal tha son of Ebed went out, N stood in tha entering of tha gate of tha city: N Abimelech rose up, N tha people dat were wit him, from lyin in wait.
N when Gaal saw tha people, he said 2 Zebul, look, there come people down from tha top of tha mountains. N Zebul said 2 him, u see tha shadow of tha mountains as if dey were men.
N Gaal spoke again N said, See there come people down by tha middle of tha land, N another company come along by tha plain of Meonenim.
Then said Zebul 2 him, Where is now ur mouth, wherewith u said, Who is Abimelech, dat we should serve him? is not dis tha people dat u have despised? go out, I pray now, N fight wit ’em.
N Gaal went out before tha men of Shechem, N fought wit Abimelech.
N Abimelech chased him, N he fled before him, N many were overthrown N wounded, even 2 tha entering of tha gate.
N Abimelech lived at Arumah: N Zebul thrust out Gaal N his brothers, dat dey should not live in Shechem.
N it happened on tha morrow, dat tha people went out in2 tha field; N dey told Abimelech.
N he took tha people, N divided ’em in2 three companies, N laid wait in tha field, N looked, N, look, tha people were come forth out of tha city; N he rose up against ’em, N struck ’em.
N Abimelech, N tha company dat was wit him, rushed forward, N stood in tha entering of tha gate of tha city: N tha two other companies ran upon all tha people dat were in tha fields, N killed ’em.
N Abimelech fought against tha city all dat day; N he took tha city, N killed tha people dat was in it, N beat down tha city, N sowed it wit salt.
N when all tha men of tha tower of Shechem heard dat, dey entered in2 an hold of tha house of tha god Berith.
N it was told Abimelech, dat all tha men of tha tower of Shechem were gathered together.

N Abimelech got him up 2 mount Zalmon, he N all tha people dat were wit him; N Abimelech took an axe in his hand, N cut down a bough from tha trees, N took it, N laid it on his shoulder, N said 2 tha people dat were wit him, What y’all have seen me do, make haste, N do as I have done.

N all tha people likewise cut down every man his bough, N followed Abimelech, N put ’em 2 tha hold, N set tha hold on fire upon ’em; so dat all tha men of tha tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men N women.
Then went Abimelech 2 Thebez, N encamped against Thebez, N took it.
But there was a strong tower within tha city, N there fled all tha men N women, N all dey of tha city, N shut it 2 ’em, N got ’em up 2 tha top of tha tower.
N Abimelech came 2 tha tower, N fought against it, N went hard 2 tha door of tha tower 2 burn it wit fire.
N a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, N all 2 broke his skull.
Then he called hastily 2 tha young man his armourbearer, N said 2 him, Draw ur sword, N kill me, dat men say not of me, A woman killed him. N his young man thrust him through, N he died.
N when tha men of Israel saw dat Abimelech was dead, dey departed every man 2 his place.
Like dis God rendered tha wickedness of Abimelech, which he did 2 his father, in slaying his seventy brothers:
N all tha evil of tha men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: N upon ’em came tha curse of Jotham tha son of Jerubbaal.

10.text: N after Abimelech there arose 2 defend Israel Tola tha son of Puah, tha son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; N he lived in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
N he judged Israel twenty N three years, N died, N was buried in Shamir.
N after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, N judged Israel twenty N two years.
N he had thirty sons dat rode on thirty ass colts, N dey had thirty citiez, which r called Havoth-jair 2 dis day, which r in tha land of Gilead.
N Jair died, N was buried in Camon.

N tha children of Israel did evil again in tha sight of tha LORD, N served Baalim, N Ashtaroth, N tha gods of Syria, N tha gods of Zidon, N tha gods of Moab, N tha gods of tha children of Ammon, N tha gods of tha Philistines, N forsook tha LORD, N served not him.
N tha anger of tha LORD was hot against Israel, N he sold ’em in2 tha hands of tha Philistines, N in2 tha hands of tha children of Ammon.
N dat year dey vexed N oppressed tha children of Israel: eighteen years, all tha children of Israel dat were on tha other side Jordan in tha land of tha Amorites, which is in Gilead.
Moreover tha children of Ammon passed over Jordan 2 fight also against Judah, N against Benjamin, N against tha house of Ephraim; so dat Israel was sore distressed.
N tha children of Israel cried 2 tha LORD, sayin, We have sinned against u, both because we have forsaken our God, N also served Baalim.
N tha LORD said 2 tha children of Israel, Did not I deliver u from tha Egyptians, N from tha Amorites, from tha children of Ammon, N from tha Philistines?
Tha Zidonians also, N tha Amalekites, N tha Maonites, did oppress u; N y’all cried 2 me, N I delivered u out of their hand.
Yet y’all have forsaken me, N served other gods: so I will deliver u no more.
Go N cry 2 tha gods which y’all have chosen; let ’em deliver u in tha time of ur tribulation.
N tha children of Israel said 2 tha LORD, We have sinned: do u 2 us whatever seems good 2 u; deliver us only, we pray u, dis day.
N dey put away tha strange gods from among ’em, N served tha LORD: N his soul was grieved 4 tha misery of Israel.
Then tha children of Ammon were gathered together, N encamped in Gilead. N tha children of Israel assembled themselves together, N encamped in Mizpeh.
N tha people N princes of Gilead said one 2 another, What man is he dat will begin 2 fight against tha children of Ammon? he shall be head over all tha inhabitants of Gilead.

11.text: Now Jephthah tha Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, N he was tha son of an harlot: N Gilead fathered Jephthah.
N Gilead’s wife bare him sons; N his wife’s sons grew up, N dey thrust out Jephthah, N said 2 him, u will not inherit in our father’s house; 4 u r tha son of a strange woman.
Then Jephthah fled from his brothers, N lived in tha land of Tob: N there were gathered vain men 2 Jephthah, N went out wit him.
N it happened in process of time, dat tha children of Ammon made war against Israel.
N it was so, dat when tha children of Ammon made war against Israel, tha elders of Gilead went 2 fetch Jephthah out of tha land of Tob:
N dey said 2 Jephthah, Come, N be our captain, dat we may fight wit tha children of Ammon.
N Jephthah said 2 tha elders of Gilead, Did not y’all hate me, N expel me out of my father’s house? N why r y’all come 2 me now when y’all r in distress?
N tha elders of Gilead said 2 Jephthah, Therefore we turn again 2 u now, dat u may go wit us, N fight against tha children of Ammon, N be our head over all tha inhabitants of Gilead.
N Jephthah said 2 tha elders of Gilead, If y’all bring me home again 2 fight against tha children of Ammon, N tha LORD deliver ’em before me, shall I be ur head?
N tha elders of Gilead said 2 Jephthah, tha LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according 2 ur words.
Then Jephthah went wit tha elders of Gilead, N tha people made him head N captain over ’em: N Jephthah uttered all his words before tha LORD in Mizpeh.
N Jephthah sent messengers 2 tha king of tha children of Ammon, sayin, What have u 2 do wit me, dat u r come against me 2 fight in my land?

N tha king of tha children of Ammon answered 2 tha messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when dey came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even 2 Jabbok, N 2 Jordan: now therefore restore dose lands again peaceably.
N Jephthah sent messengers again 2 tha king of tha children of Ammon:
N said 2 him, like dis says Jephthah, Israel took not away tha land of Moab, nor tha land of tha children of Ammon:
But when Israel came up from Egypt, N walked through tha wilderness 2 tha Red sea, N came 2 Kadesh;

Then Israel sent messengers 2 tha king of Edom, sayin, Let me, I pray u, pass through ur land: but tha king of Edom would not listen thereto. N in like manner dey sent 2 tha king of Moab: but he would not consent: N Israel stayed in Kadesh.

Then dey went along through tha wilderness, N compassed tha land of Edom, N tha land of Moab, N came by tha east side of tha land of Moab, N pitched on tha other side of Arnon, but came not within tha border of Moab: 4 Arnon was tha border of Moab.
N Israel sent messengers 2 Sihon king of tha Amorites, tha king of Heshbon; N Israel said 2 him, Let us pass, we pray u, through ur land in2 my place.
But Sihon trusted not Israel 2 pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, N pitched in Jahaz, N fought against Israel.
N tha LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon N all his people in2 tha hand of Israel, N dey struck ’em: so Israel possessed all tha land of tha Amorites, tha inhabitants of dat country.
N dey possessed all tha coasts of tha Amorites, from Arnon even 2 Jabbok, N from tha wilderness even 2 Jordan.
So now tha LORD God of Israel has dispossessed tha Amorites from before his people Israel, N should u possess it?
Wilt not u possess dat which Chemosh ur god gives u 2 possess? So whoever tha LORD our God shall drive out from before us, ’em will we possess.
N now r u any thing better than Balak tha son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against ’em,

While Israel lived in Heshbon N her towns, N in Aroer N her towns, N in all tha citiez dat be along by tha coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did y’all not recover ’em within dat time?
So I have not sinned against u, but u do me wrong 2 war against me: tha LORD tha Judge be judge dis day between tha children of Israel N tha children of Ammon.
But tha king of tha children of Ammon listened not 2 tha words of Jephthah which he sent him.
Then tha Spirit of tha LORD came upon Jephthah, N he passed over Gilead, N Manasseh, N passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, N from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over 2 tha children of Ammon.
N Jephthah vowed a vow 2 tha LORD, N said, If u will without fail deliver tha children of Ammon in2 mine hands,
Then it shall be, dat whatever comes forth of tha doors of my house 2 meet me, when I return in peace from tha children of Ammon, shall surely be tha LORD’s, N I will offer it up 4 a burnt offering.
So Jephthah passed over 2 tha children of Ammon 2 fight against ’em; N tha LORD delivered ’em in2 his hands.

N he struck ’em from Aroer, even till u come 2 Minnith, even twenty citiez, N 2 tha plain of tha vineyards, wit a very great slaughter. like dis tha children of Ammon were subdued before tha children of Israel.
N Jephthah came 2 Mizpeh 2 his house, N, look, his daughter came out 2 meet him wit timbrels N wit dances: N she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

N it happened, when he saw her, dat he rent his clothes, N said, Alas, my daughter! u have brought me very low, N u r one of ’em dat trouble me: 4 I have opened my mouth 2 tha LORD, N I cannot go back.

N she said 2 him, My father, if u have opened ur mouth 2 tha LORD, do 2 me according 2 dat which has proceeded out of ur mouth; forasmuch as tha LORD has taken vengeance 4 u of thine opps, even of tha children of Ammon.
N she said 2 her father, Let dis thing be done 4 me: let me alone two months, dat I may go up N down upon tha mountains, N bewail my virginity, I N my fellows.
N he said, Go. N he sent her away 4 two months: N she went wit her companions, N bewailed her virginity upon tha mountains.
N it happened at tha end of two months, dat she returned 2 her father, who did wit her according 2 his vow which he had vowed: N she knew no man. N it was a custom in Israel,
Dat tha daughters of Israel went yearly 2 lament tha daughter of Jephthah tha Gileadite four days in a year.

12.text: N tha men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, N went northward, N said 2 Jephthah, so passedst u over 2 fight against tha children of Ammon, N did not call us 2 go wit u? we will burn thine house upon u wit fire.
N Jephthah said 2 ’em, I N my people were at great strife wit tha children of Ammon; N when I called u, y’all delivered me not out of their hands.

N when I saw dat y’all delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, N passed over against tha children of Ammon, N tha LORD delivered ’em in2 my hand: so then r y’all come up 2 me dis day, 2 fight against me?

Then Jephthah gathered together all tha men of Gilead, N fought wit Ephraim: N tha men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because dey said, y’all Gileadites r fugitives of Ephraim among tha Ephraimites, N among tha Manassites.

N tha Gileadites took tha passages of Jordan before tha Ephraimites: N it was so, dat when dose Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; dat tha men of Gilead said 2 him, r u an Ephraimite? If he said, no;

Then said dey 2 him, Say now Shibboleth: N he said Sibboleth: 4 he could not frame 2 pronounce it right. Then dey took him, N killed him at tha passages of Jordan: N there fell at dat time of tha Ephraimites forty N two thousand.
N Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah tha Gileadite, N was buried in one of tha citiez of Gilead.
N after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel.
N he had thirty sons, N thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, N took in thirty daughters from abroad 4 his sons. N he judged Israel seven years.
Then died Ibzan, N was buried at Beth-lehem.
N after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; N he judged Israel ten years.
N Elon tha Zebulonite died, N was buried in Aijalon in tha country of Zebulun.
N after him Abdon tha son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
N he had forty sons N thirty nephews, dat rode on threescore N ten ass colts: N he judged Israel eight years.
N Abdon tha son of Hillel tha Pirathonite died, N was buried in Pirathon in tha land of Ephraim, in tha mount of tha Amalekites.

13.text: N tha children of Israel did evil again in tha sight of tha LORD; N tha LORD delivered ’em in2 tha hand of tha Philistines forty years.
N there was a certain man of Zorah, of tha family of tha Danites, whose name was Manoah; N his wife was barren, N bare not.
N tha angel of tha LORD appeared 2 tha woman, N said 2 her, look now, u r barren, N bear not: but u will conceive, N bear a son.
Now therefore beware, I pray u, N drink not wine nor strong drink, N eat not any unclean thing:
4, look, u will conceive, N bear a son; N no razor shall come on his head: 4 tha child shall be a Nazarite 2 God from tha womb: N he shall begin 2 deliver Israel out of tha hand of tha Philistines.

Then tha woman came N told her husband, sayin, A man of God came 2 me, N his countenance was like tha countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not from where he was, neither told he me his name:
But he said 2 me, look, u will conceive, N bear a son; N now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: 4 tha child shall be a Nazarite 2 God from tha womb 2 tha day of his death.
Then Manoah intreated tha LORD, N said, O my Lord, let tha man of God which u did send come again 2 us, N teach us what we shall do 2 tha child dat shall be born.
N God listened 2 tha voice of Manoah; N tha angel of God came again 2 tha woman as she sat in tha field: but Manoah her husband was not wit her.
N tha woman made haste, N ran, N showed her husband, N said 2 him, look, tha man has appeared 2 me, dat came 2 me tha other day.
N Manoah arose, N went after his wife, N came 2 tha man, N said 2 him, r u tha man dat spoke 2 tha woman? N he said, I am.
N Manoah said, Now let ur words come 2 pass. How shall we order tha child, N how shall we do 2 him?
N tha angel of tha LORD said 2 Manoah, Of all dat I said 2 tha woman let her beware.
She may not eat of any thing dat comes of tha vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all dat I commanded her let her observe.
N Manoah said 2 tha angel of tha LORD, I pray u, let us detain u, until we shall have made ready a kid 4 u.

N tha angel of tha LORD said 2 Manoah, Though u detain me, I will not eat of ur bread: N if u will offer a burnt offering, u must offer it 2 tha LORD. 4 Manoah knew not dat he was an angel of tha LORD.
N Manoah said 2 tha angel of tha LORD, What is ur name, dat when ur sayings come 2 pass we may do u honour?
N tha angel of tha LORD said 2 him, Why ask u like dis after my name, seein it is secret?
So Manoah took a kid wit a food offering, N offered it upon a rock 2 tha LORD: N tha angel did wondrously; N Manoah N his wife looked on.

4 it happened, when tha flame went up toward heaven from off tha altar, dat tha angel of tha LORD ascended in tha flame of tha altar. N Manoah N his wife looked on it, N fell on their faces 2 tha ground.
But tha angel of tha LORD did no more appear 2 Manoah N 2 his wife. Then Manoah knew dat he was an angel of tha LORD.
N Manoah said 2 his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

But his wife said 2 him, If tha LORD were pleased 2 kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering N a food offering at our hands, neither would he have showed us all dese things, nor would as at dis time have told us such things as dese.
N tha woman bare a son, N called his name Samson: N tha child grew, N tha LORD blessed him.
N tha Spirit of tha LORD began 2 move him at times in tha camp of Dan between Zorah N Eshtaol.

14.text: N Samson went down 2 Timnath, N saw a woman in Timnath of tha daughters of tha Philistines.
N he came up, N told his father N his mother, N said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of tha daughters of tha Philistines: now therefore get her 4 me 2 wife.

Then his father N his mother said 2 him, Is there never a woman among tha daughters of ur brothers, or among all my people, dat u go 2 take a wife of tha uncircumcised Philistines? N Samson said 2 his father, Get her 4 me; 4 she pleaseth me well.
But his father N his mother knew not dat it was of tha LORD, dat he sought an occasion against tha Philistines: 4 at dat time tha Philistines had dominion over Israel.
Then went Samson down, N his father N his mother, 2 Timnath, N came 2 tha vineyards of Timnath: N, look, a young lion roared against him.
N tha Spirit of tha LORD came mightily upon him, N he rent him as he would have rent a kid, N he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
N he went down, N talked wit tha woman; N she pleased Samson well.
N after a time he returned 2 take her, N he turned aside 2 see tha carcase of tha lion: N, look, there was a swarm of bees N honey in tha carcase of tha lion.
N he took of it in his hands, N went on eatin, N came 2 his father N mother, N he gave ’em, N dey did eat: but he told not ’em dat he had taken tha honey out of tha carcase of tha lion.
So his father went down 2 tha woman: N Samson made there a feast; 4 so used tha young men 2 do.
N it happened, when dey saw him, dat dey brought thirty companions 2 be wit him.

N Samson said 2 ’em, I will now put forth a riddle 2 u: if y’all can certainly declare it me within tha seven days of tha feast, N find it out, then I will give u thirty sheets N thirty change of garments:
But if y’all cannot declare it me, then shall y’all give me thirty sheets N thirty change of garments. N dey said 2 him, Put forth ur riddle, dat we may hear it.
N he said 2 ’em, Out of tha eater came forth food, N out of tha strong came forth sweetness. N dey could not in three days expound tha riddle.

N it happened on tha seventh day, dat dey said 2 Samson’s wife, Entice ur husband, dat he may declare 2 us tha riddle, lest we burn u N ur father’s house wit fire: have y’all called us 2 take dat we have? is it not so?

N Samson’s wife wept before him, N said, u do but hate me, N love me not: u have put forth a riddle 2 tha children of my people, N have not told it me. N he said 2 her, look, I have not told it my father nor my mother, N shall I tell it u?
N she wept before him tha seven days, while their feast lasted: N it happened on tha seventh day, dat he told her, because she lay sore upon him: N she told tha riddle 2 tha children of her people.

N tha men of tha city said 2 him on tha seventh day before tha sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? N what is stronger than a lion? N he said 2 ’em, If y’all had not plowed wit my heifer, y’all had not found out my riddle.

N tha Spirit of tha LORD came upon him, N he went down 2 Ashkelon, N killed thirty men of ’em, N took their spoil, N gave change of garments 2 ’em which expounded tha riddle. N his anger was kindled, N he went up 2 his father’s house.
But Samson’s wife was given 2 his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

15.text: But it happened within a while after, in tha time of wheat harvest, dat Samson visited his wife wit a kid; N he said, I will go in 2 my wife in2 tha chamber. But her father would not suffer him 2 go in.
N her father said, I for real thought dat u had utterly hated her; therefore I gave her 2 ur companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray u, instead of her.
N Samson said concerning ’em, Now shall I be more blameless than tha Philistines, though I do ’em a displeasure.
N Samson went N caught three hundred foxes, N took firebrands, N turned tail 2 tail, N put a firebrand in tha midst between two tails.
N when he had set tha brands on fire, he let ’em go in2 tha standin corn of tha Philistines, N burnt up both tha shocks, N also tha standin corn, wit tha vineyards N olives.

Then tha Philistines said, Who has done dis? N dey answered, Samson, tha son in law of tha Timnite, because he had taken his wife, N given her 2 his companion. N tha Philistines came up, N burnt her N her father wit fire.
N Samson said 2 ’em, Though y’all have done dis, yet will I be avenged of u, N after dat I will cease.
N he struck ’em hip N thigh wit a great slaughter: N he went down N lived in tha top of tha rock Etam.
Then tha Philistines went up, N pitched in Judah, N spread themselves in Lehi.
N tha men of Judah said, Why r y’all come up against us? N dey answered, 2 bind Samson r we come up, 2 do 2 him as he has done 2 us.

Then three thousand men of Judah went 2 tha top of tha rock Etam, N said 2 Samson, know u not dat tha Philistines r rulers over us? what is dis dat u have done 2 us? N he said 2 ’em, As dey did 2 me, so have I done 2 ’em.
N dey said 2 him, We r come down 2 bind u, dat we may deliver u in2 tha hand of tha Philistines. N Samson said 2 ’em, Swear 2 me, dat y’all will not fall upon me y’all.
N dey spoke 2 him, sayin, No; but we will bind u fast, N deliver u in2 their hand: but surely we will not kill u. N dey bound him wit two new cords, N brought him up from tha rock.

N when he came 2 Lehi, tha Philistines shouted against him: N tha Spirit of tha LORD came mightily upon him, N tha cords dat were upon his arms became as flax dat was burnt wit fire, N his bands loosed from off his hands.
N he found a new jawbone of an ass, N put forth his hand, N took it, N killed a thousand men wit it.
N Samson said, wit tha jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, wit tha jaw of an ass have I killed a thousand men.
N it happened, when he had made an end of speakin, dat he cast away tha jawbone out of his hand, N called dat place Ramath-lehi.
N he was sore athirst, N called on tha LORD, N said, u have given dis great deliverance in2 tha hand of ur servant: N now shall I die 4 thirst, N fall in2 tha hand of tha uncircumcised?

But God clave an hollow place dat was in tha jaw, N there came water thereout; N when he had drunk, his spirit came again, N he revived: so he called tha name of it En-hakkore, which is in Lehi 2 dis day.
N he judged Israel in tha days of tha Philistines twenty years.

16.text: Then went Samson 2 Gaza, N saw there an harlot, N went in 2 her.

N it was told tha Gazites, sayin, Samson is come here. N dey compassed him in, N laid wait 4 him all night in tha gate of tha city, N were quiet all tha night, sayin, In tha morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

N Samson lay till midnight, N arose at midnight, N took tha doors of tha gate of tha city, N tha two posts, N went away wit ’em, bar N all, N put ’em upon his shoulders, N carried ’em up 2 tha top of an hill dat is before Hebron.
N it happened afterward, dat he loved a woman in tha valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

N tha lords of tha Philistines came up 2 her, N said 2 her, Entice him, N see in which his great strength lies, N by what means we may prevail against him, dat we may bind him 2 afflict him: N we will give u every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.
N Delilah said 2 Samson, Tell me, I pray u, in which ur great strength lies, N wherewith u might be bound 2 afflict u.
N Samson said 2 her, If dey bind me wit seven green withs dat were never dried, then shall I be weak, N be as another man.
Then tha lords of tha Philistines brought up 2 her seven green withs which had not been dried, N she bound him wit ’em.

Now there were men lyin in wait, abiding wit her in tha chamber. N she said 2 him, tha Philistines be upon u, Samson. N he broke tha withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it touches tha fire. So his strength was not known.
N Delilah said 2 Samson, look, u have mocked me, N told me lies: now tell me, I pray u, wherewith u might be bound.
N he said 2 her, If dey bind me fast wit new ropes dat never were occupied, then shall I be weak, N be as another man.

Delilah therefore took new ropes, N bound him wit it, N said 2 him, tha Philistines be upon u, Samson. N there were liers in wait abiding in tha chamber. N he broke ’em from off his arms like a thread.
N Delilah said 2 Samson, until now u have mocked me, N told me lies: tell me wherewith u might be bound. N he said 2 her, If u weavest tha seven locks of my head wit tha web.
N she fastened it wit tha pin, N said 2 him, tha Philistines be upon u, Samson. N he awaked out of his sleep, N went away wit tha pin of tha beam, N wit tha web.
N she said 2 him, How can u say, I love u, when thine heart is not wit me? u have mocked me dese three times, N have not told me in which ur great strength lies.
N it happened, when she pressed him daily wit her words, N urged him, so dat his soul was vexed 2 death;

Dat he told her all his heart, N said 2 her, There has not come a razor upon mine head; 4 I have been a Nazarite 2 God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, N I shall become weak, N be like any other man.

N when Delilah saw dat he had told her all his heart, she sent N called 4 tha lords of tha Philistines, sayin, Come up dis once, 4 he has showed me all his heart. Then tha lords of tha Philistines came up 2 her, N brought money in their hand.
N she made him sleep upon her knees; N she called 4 a man, N she caused him 2 shave off tha seven locks of his head; N she began 2 afflict him, N his strength went from him.
N she said, tha Philistines be upon u, Samson. N he awoke out of his sleep, N said, I will go out as at other times before, N shake myself. N he knew not dat tha LORD was departed from him.
But tha Philistines took him, N put out his eyes, N brought him down 2 Gaza, N bound him wit fetters of brass; N he did grind in tha prison house.
But tha hair of his head began 2 grow again after he was shaven.
Then tha lords of tha Philistines gathered ’em together 4 2 offer a great sacrifice 2 Dagon their god, N 2 rejoice: 4 dey said, Our god has delivered Samson our opp in2 our hand.
N when tha people saw him, dey praised their god: 4 dey said, Our god has delivered in2 our hands our opp, N tha destroyer of our country, which killed many of us.

N it happened, when their hearts were merry, dat dey said, Call 4 Samson, dat he may make us sport. N dey called 4 Samson out of tha prison house; N he made ’em sport: N dey set him between tha pillars.
N Samson said 2 tha lad dat held him by tha hand, Suffer me dat I may feel tha pillars whereupon tha house stands, dat I may lean upon ’em.
Now tha house was full of men N women; N all tha lords of tha Philistines were there; N there were upon tha roof about three thousand men N women, dat beheld while Samson made sport.
N Samson called 2 tha LORD, N said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray u, N strengthen me, I pray u, only dis once, O God, dat I may be at once avenged of tha Philistines 4 my two eyes.
N Samson took hold of tha two middle pillars upon which tha house stood, N on which it was borne up, of tha one wit his right hand, N of tha other wit his left.

N Samson said, Let me die wit tha Philistines. N he bowed himself wit all his might; N tha house fell upon tha lords, N upon all tha people dat were in it. So tha dead which he killed at his death were more than dey which he killed in his life.

Then his brothers N all tha house of his father came down, N took him, N brought him up, N buried him between Zorah N Eshtaol in tha buryingplace of Manoah his father. N he judged Israel twenty years.

17.text: N there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

N he said 2 his mother, tha eleven hundred shekels of silver dat were taken from u, about which u cursedst, N spoke of also in mine ears, look, tha silver is wit me; I took it. N his mother said, Blessed be u of tha LORD, my son.

N when he had restored tha eleven hundred shekels of silver 2 his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated tha silver 2 tha LORD from my hand 4 my son, 2 make a graven image N a molten image: now therefore I will restore it 2 u.
Yet he restored tha money 2 his mother; N his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, N gave ’em 2 tha founder, who made of it a graven image N a molten image: N dey were in tha house of Micah.
N tha man Micah had an house of gods, N made an ephod, N teraphim, N consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
In dose days there was no king in Israel, but every man did dat which was right in his own eyes.
N there was a young man out of Beth-lehem-judah of tha family of Judah, who was a Levite, N he stayed there.
N tha man departed out of tha city from Beth-lehem-judah 2 stay where he could find a place: N he came 2 mount Ephraim 2 tha house of Micah, as he journeyed.
N Micah said 2 him, from where come u? N he said 2 him, I am a Levite of Beth-lehem-judah, N I go 2 stay where I may find a place.
N Micah said 2 him, live wit me, N be 2 me a father N a priest, N I will give u ten shekels of silver by tha year, N a suit of clothing, N ur food. So tha Levite went in.
N tha Levite was content 2 live wit tha man; N tha young man was 2 him as one of his sons.
N Micah consecrated tha Levite; N tha young man became his priest, N was in tha house of Micah.
Then said Micah, Now know I dat tha LORD will do me good, seein I have a Levite 2 my priest.

18.text: In dose days there was no king in Israel: N in dose days tha tribe of tha Danites sought ’em an inheritance 2 live in; 4 2 dat day all their inheritance had not fallen 2 ’em among tha tribes of Israel.

N tha children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, N from Eshtaol, 2 spy out tha land, N 2 search it; N dey said 2 ’em, Go, search tha land: who when dey came 2 mount Ephraim, 2 tha house of Micah, dey lodged there.
When dey were by tha house of Micah, dey knew tha voice of tha young man tha Levite: N dey turned in there, N said 2 him, Who brought u here? N what make u in dis place? N what have u here?
N he said 2 ’em, like dis N like dis deals Micah wit me, N has hired me, N I am his priest.
N dey said 2 him, Ask counsel, we pray u, of God, dat we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
N tha priest said 2 ’em, Go in peace: before tha LORD is ur way in which y’all go.

Then tha five men departed, N came 2 Laish, N saw tha people dat were in it, how dey lived careless, after tha manner of tha Zidonians, quiet N secure; N there was no magistrate in tha land, dat might put ’em 2 shame in any thing; N dey were far from tha Zidonians, N had no business wit any man.
N dey came 2 their brothers 2 Zorah N Eshtaol: N their brothers said 2 ’em, What say y’all?
N dey said, Arise, dat we may go up against ’em: 4 we have seen tha land, N, look, it is very good: N r y’all still? don’t be slothful 2 go, N 2 enter 2 possess tha land.
When y’all go, y’all shall come 2 a people secure, N 2 a large land: 4 God has given it in2 ur hands; a place where there is no want of any thing dat is in tha earth.
N there went from thence of tha family of tha Danites, out of Zorah N out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed wit weapons of war.
N dey went up, N pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: so dey called dat place Mahaneh-dan 2 dis day: look, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.
N dey passed thence 2 mount Ephraim, N came 2 tha house of Micah.

Then answered tha five men dat went 2 spy out tha country of Laish, N said 2 their brothers, do y’all know dat there is in dese houses an ephod, N teraphim, N a graven image, N a molten image? now therefore consider what y’all have 2 do.
N dey turned thitherward, N came 2 tha house of tha young man tha Levite, even 2 tha house of Micah, N greeted him.
N tha six hundred men appointed wit their weapons of war, which were of tha children of Dan, stood by tha entering of tha gate.

N tha five men dat went 2 spy out tha land went up, N came in there, N took tha graven image, N tha ephod, N tha teraphim, N tha molten image: N tha priest stood in tha entering of tha gate wit tha six hundred men dat were appointed wit weapons of war.
N dese went in2 Micah’s house, N fetched tha carved image, tha ephod, N tha teraphim, N tha molten image. Then said tha priest 2 ’em, What do y’all?

N dey said 2 him, Hold ur peace, lay thine hand upon ur mouth, N go wit us, N be 2 us a father N a priest: is it better 4 u 2 be a priest 2 tha house of one man, or dat u be a priest 2 a tribe N a family in Israel?
N tha priest’s heart was glad, N he took tha ephod, N tha teraphim, N tha graven image, N went in tha midst of tha people.
So dey turned N departed, N put tha little ones N tha cattle N tha carriage before ’em.
N when dey were a good way from tha house of Micah, tha men dat were in tha houses near 2 Micah’s house were gathered together, N overtook tha children of Dan.
N dey cried 2 tha children of Dan. N dey turned their faces, N said 2 Micah, What ails u, dat u come wit such a company?
N he said, y’all have taken away my gods which I made, N tha priest, N y’all r gone away: N what have I more? N what is dis dat y’all say 2 me, What ails u?
N tha children of Dan said 2 him, don’t let ur voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon u, N u lose ur life, wit tha lives of ur household.
N tha children of Dan went their way: N when Micah saw dat dey were too strong 4 him, he turned N went back 2 his house.
N dey took tha things which Micah had made, N tha priest which he had, N came 2 Laish, 2 a people dat were at quiet N secure: N dey struck ’em wit tha edge of tha sword, N burnt tha city wit fire.
N there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, N dey had no business wit any man; N it was in tha valley dat lies by Beth-rehob. N dey built a city, N lived in it.
N dey called tha name of tha city Dan, after tha name of Dan their father, who was born 2 Israel: but tha name of tha city was Laish at tha first.
N tha children of Dan set up tha graven image: N Jonathan, tha son of Gershom, tha son of Manasseh, he N his sons were priests 2 tha tribe of Dan until tha day of tha captivity of tha land.
N dey set ’em up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all tha time dat tha house of God was in Shiloh.

19.text: N it happened in dose days, when there was no king in Israel, dat there was a certain Levite stayin on tha side of mount Ephraim, who took 2 him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.
N his concubine played tha whore against him, N went away from him 2 her father’s house 2 Beth-lehem-judah, N was there four whole months.

N her husband arose, N went after her, 2 speak friendly 2 her, N 2 bring her again, havin his servant wit him, N a couple of asses: N she brought him in2 her father’s house: N when tha father of tha damsel saw him, he rejoiced 2 meet him.
N his father in law, tha damsel’s father, retained him; N he stayed wit him three days: so dey did eat N drink, N lodged there.

N it happened on tha fourth day, when dey arose early in tha morning, dat he rose up 2 depart: N tha damsel’s father said 2 his son in law, Comfort thine heart wit a morsel of bread, N afterward go ur way.
N dey sat down, N did eat N drink both of ’em together: 4 tha damsel’s father had said 2 tha man, Be content, I pray u, N tarry all night, N let thine heart be merry.
N when tha man rose up 2 depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
N he arose early in tha morning on tha fifth day 2 depart: N tha damsel’s father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray u. N dey tarried until afternoon, N dey did eat both of ’em.

N when tha man rose up 2 depart, he, N his concubine, N his servant, his father in law, tha damsel’s father, said 2 him, look, now tha day draws toward evening, I pray u tarry all night: look, tha day grows 2 an end, lodge here, dat thine heart may be merry; N 2 morrow get u early on ur way, dat u may go home.
But tha man would not tarry dat night, but he rose up N departed, N came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; N there were wit him two asses saddled, his concubine also was wit him.
N when dey were by Jebus, tha day was far spent; N tha servant said 2 his master, Come, I pray u, N let us turn in in2 dis city of tha Jebusites, N lodge in it.
N his master said 2 him, We will not turn aside here in2 tha city of a stranger, dat is not of tha children of Israel; we will pass over 2 Gibeah.
N he said 2 his servant, Come, N let us draw near 2 one of dese places 2 lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
N dey passed on N went their way; N tha sun went down upon ’em when dey were by Gibeah, which belongs 2 Benjamin.
N dey turned aside there, 2 go in N 2 lodge in Gibeah: N when he went in, he sat him down in a street of tha city: 4 there was no man dat took ’em in2 his house 2 lodging.
N, look, there came an old man from his work out of tha field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; N he stayed in Gibeah: but tha men of tha place were Benjamites.
N when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in tha street of tha city: N tha old man said, where go u? N from where come u?

N he said 2 him, We r passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward tha side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: N I went 2 Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now goin 2 tha house of tha LORD; N there is no man dat receives me 2 house.
Yet there is both straw N provender 4 our asses; N there is bread N wine also 4 me, N 4 ur handmaid, N 4 tha young man which is wit ur servants: there is no want of any thing.
N tha old man said, Peace be wit u; howsoever let all ur wants lie upon me; only lodge not in tha street.
So he brought him in2 his house, N gave provender 2 tha asses: N dey washed their feet, N did eat N drink.

Now as dey were makin their hearts merry, look, tha men of tha city, certain sons of Belial, beset tha house round about, N beat at tha door, N spoke 2 tha master of tha house, tha old man, sayin, Bring forth tha man dat came in2 thine house, dat we may know him.
