N tha man, tha master of tha house, went out 2 ’em, N said 2 ’em, no, my brothers, no, I pray u, do not so wickedly; seein dat dis man is come in2 mine house, do not dis folly.
Look, here is my daughter a maiden, N his concubine; ’em I will bring out now, N humble y’all ’em, N do wit ’em what seems good 2 u: but 2 dis man do not so vile a thing.

But tha men would not listen 2 him: so tha man took his concubine, N brought her forth 2 ’em; N dey knew her, N abused her all tha night until tha morning: N when tha day began 2 spring, dey let her go.
Then came tha woman in tha dawning of tha day, N fell down at tha door of tha man’s house where her lord was, till it was light.

N her lord rose up in tha morning, N opened tha doors of tha house, N went out 2 go his way: N, look, tha woman his concubine was fallen down at tha door of tha house, N her hands were upon tha threshold.
N he said 2 her, Up, N let us be goin. But none answered. Then tha man took her up upon an ass, N tha man rose up, N got him 2 his place.
N when he was come in2 his house, he took a knife, N laid hold on his concubine, N divided her, together wit her bones, in2 twelve pieces, N sent her in2 all tha coasts of Israel.

N it was so, dat all dat saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from tha day dat tha children of Israel came up out of tha land of Egypt 2 dis day: consider of it, take advice, N speak ur minds.

20.text: Then all tha children of Israel went out, N tha congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even 2 Beer-sheba, wit tha land of Gilead, 2 tha LORD in Mizpeh.
N tha chief of all tha people, even of all tha tribes of Israel, presented themselves in tha assembly of tha people of God, four hundred thousand footmen dat drew sword.
(Now tha children of Benjamin heard dat tha children of Israel were gone up 2 Mizpeh.) Then said tha children of Israel, Tell us, how was dis wickedness?
N tha Levite, tha husband of tha woman dat was killed, answered, I came in2 Gibeah dat belongs 2 Benjamin, I N my concubine, 2 lodge.
N tha men of Gibeah rose against me, N beset tha house round about upon me by night, N thought 2 have killed me: N my concubine have dey forced, dat she is dead.
N I took my concubine, N cut her in pieces, N sent her throughout all tha country of tha inheritance of Israel: 4 dey have committed lewdness N folly in Israel.
Look, y’all r all children of Israel; give here ur advice N counsel.
N all tha people arose as one man, sayin, We will not any of us go 2 his tent, neither will we any of us turn in2 his house.
But now dis shall be tha thing which we will do 2 Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

N we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all tha tribes of Israel, N an hundred of a thousand, N a thousand out of ten thousand, 2 fetch victual 4 tha people, dat dey may do, when dey come 2 Gibeah of Benjamin, according 2 all tha folly dat dey have wrought in Israel.
So all tha men of Israel were gathered against tha city, knit together as one man.
N tha tribes of Israel sent men through all tha tribe of Benjamin, sayin, What wickedness is dis dat is done among u?

Now therefore deliver us tha men, tha children of Belial, which r in Gibeah, dat we may put ’em 2 death, N put away evil from Israel. But tha children of Benjamin would not listen 2 tha voice of their brothers tha children of Israel:
But tha children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of tha citiez 2 Gibeah, 2 go out 2 battle against tha children of Israel.
N tha children of Benjamin were numbered at dat time out of tha citiez twenty N six thousand men dat drew sword, beside tha inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
Among all dis people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, N not miss.
N tha men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men dat drew sword: all dese were men of war.

N tha children of Israel arose, N went up 2 tha house of God, N asked counsel of God, N said, Which of us shall go up first 2 tha battle against tha children of Benjamin? N tha LORD said, Judah shall go up first.
N tha children of Israel rose up in tha morning, N encamped against Gibeah.
N tha men of Israel went out 2 battle against Benjamin; N tha men of Israel put themselves in array 2 fight against ’em at Gibeah.
N tha children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, N destroyed down 2 tha ground of tha Israelites dat day twenty N two thousand men.
N tha people tha men of Israel encouraged themselves, N set their battle again in array in tha place where dey put themselves in array tha first day.

(N tha children of Israel went up N wept before tha LORD until even, N asked counsel of tha LORD, sayin, Shall I go up again 2 battle against tha children of Benjamin my brother? N tha LORD said, Go up against him.)
N tha children of Israel came near against tha children of Benjamin tha second day.
N Benjamin went forth against ’em out of Gibeah tha second day, N destroyed down 2 tha ground of tha children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all dese drew tha sword.

Then all tha children of Israel, N all tha people, went up, N came 2 tha house of God, N wept, N sat there before tha LORD, N fasted dat day until even, N offered burnt offerings N peace offerings before tha LORD.
N tha children of Israel enquired of tha LORD, (4 tha ark of tha covenant of God was there in dose days,

N Phinehas, tha son of Eleazar, tha son of Aaron, stood before it in dose days,) sayin, Shall I yet again go out 2 battle against tha children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? N tha LORD said, Go up; 4 2 morrow I will deliver ’em in2 thine hand.
N Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
N tha children of Israel went up against tha children of Benjamin on tha third day, N put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

N tha children of Benjamin went out against tha people, N were drawn away from tha city; N dey began 2 strike of tha people, N kill, as at other times, in tha highways, of which one goes up 2 tha house of God, N tha other 2 Gibeah in tha field, about thirty men of Israel.
N tha children of Benjamin said, dey r struck down before us, as at tha first. But tha children of Israel said, Let us flee, N draw ’em from tha city 2 tha highways.
N all tha men of Israel rose up out of their place, N put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: N tha liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of tha meadows of Gibeah.
N there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, N tha battle was sore: but dey knew not dat evil was near ’em.
N tha LORD struck Benjamin before Israel: N tha children of Israel destroyed of tha Benjamites dat day twenty N five thousand N an hundred men: all dese drew tha sword.
So tha children of Benjamin saw dat dey were struck: 4 tha men of Israel gave place 2 tha Benjamites, because dey trusted 2 tha liers in wait which dey had set beside Gibeah.
N tha liers in wait hasted, N rushed upon Gibeah; N tha liers in wait drew themselves along, N struck all tha city wit tha edge of tha sword.
Now there was an appointed sign between tha men of Israel N tha liers in wait, dat dey should make a great flame wit smoke rise up out of tha city.
N when tha men of Israel retired in tha battle, Benjamin began 2 strike N kill of tha men of Israel about thirty persons: 4 dey said, Surely dey r struck down before us, as in tha first battle.
But when tha flame began 2 arise up out of tha city wit a pillar of smoke, tha Benjamites looked behind ’em, N, look, tha flame of tha city ascended up 2 heaven.
N when tha men of Israel turned again, tha men of Benjamin were amazed: 4 dey saw dat evil was come upon ’em.
Therefore dey turned their backs before tha men of Israel 2 tha way of tha wilderness; but tha battle overtook ’em; N ’em which came out of tha citiez dey destroyed in tha midst of ’em.
Like dis dey inclosed tha Benjamites round about, N chased ’em, N trode ’em down wit ease over against Gibeah toward tha sunrising.
N there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all dese were men of valour.
N dey turned N fled toward tha wilderness 2 tha rock of Rimmon: N dey gleaned of ’em in tha highways five thousand men; N pursued hard after ’em 2 Gidom, N killed two thousand men of ’em.
So dat all which fell dat day of Benjamin were twenty N five thousand men dat drew tha sword; all dese were men of valour.
But six hundred men turned N fled 2 tha wilderness 2 tha rock Rimmon, N stayed in tha rock Rimmon four months.

N tha men of Israel turned again upon tha children of Benjamin, N struck ’em wit tha edge of tha sword, as well tha men of every city, as tha beast, N all dat came 2 hand: also dey set on fire all tha citiez dat dey came 2.

21.text: Now tha men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, sayin, There shall not any of us give his daughter 2 Benjamin 2 wife.
N tha people came 2 tha house of God, N stayed there till even before God, N raised their voices, N wept sore;
N said, O LORD God of Israel, why is dis come 2 pass in Israel, dat there should be 2 day one tribe lacking in Israel?
N it happened on tha morrow, dat tha people rose early, N built there an altar, N offered burnt offerings N peace offerings.

N tha children of Israel said, Who is there among all tha tribes of Israel dat came not up wit tha congregation 2 tha LORD? 4 dey had made a great oath concerning him dat came not up 2 tha LORD 2 Mizpeh, sayin, He shall surely be put 2 death.
N tha children of Israel repented ’em 4 Benjamin their brother, N said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel dis day.
How shall we do 4 wives 4 ’em dat remain, seein we have sworn by tha LORD dat we will not give ’em of our daughters 2 wives?
N dey said, What one is there of tha tribes of Israel dat came not up 2 Mizpeh 2 tha LORD? N, look, there came none 2 tha camp from Jabesh-gilead 2 tha assembly.
4 tha people were numbered, N, look, there were none of tha inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
N tha congregation sent there twelve thousand men of tha valiantest, N commanded ’em, sayin, Go N strike tha inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead wit tha edge of tha sword, wit tha women N tha children.
N dis is tha thing dat y’all shall do, y’all shall utterly destroy every male, N every woman dat has lain by man.
N dey found among tha inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, dat had known no man by lyin wit any male: N dey brought ’em 2 tha camp 2 Shiloh, which is in tha land of Canaan.
N tha whole congregation sent some 2 speak 2 tha children of Benjamin dat were in tha rock Rimmon, N 2 call peaceably 2 ’em.
N Benjamin came again at dat time; N dey gave ’em wives which dey had saved alive of tha women of Jabesh-gilead: N yet so dey sufficed ’em not.
N tha people repented ’em 4 Benjamin, because dat tha LORD had made a breach in tha tribes of Israel.
Then tha elders of tha congregation said, How shall we do 4 wives 4 ’em dat remain, seein tha women r destroyed out of Benjamin?
N dey said, There must be an inheritance 4 ’em dat be escaped of Benjamin, dat a tribe don’t be destroyed out of Israel.
But we may not give ’em wives of our daughters: 4 tha children of Israel have sworn, sayin, Cursed be he dat gives a wife 2 Benjamin.

Then dey said, look, there is a feast of tha LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on tha north side of Beth-el, on tha east side of tha highway dat goes up from Beth-el 2 Shechem, N on tha south of Lebonah.
Therefore dey commanded tha children of Benjamin, sayin, Go N lie in wait in tha vineyards;
N see, N, look, if tha daughters of Shiloh come out 2 dance in dances, then come y’all out of tha vineyards, N catch u every man his wife of tha daughters of Shiloh, N go 2 tha land of Benjamin.

N it will be, when their fathers or their brothers come 2 us 2 complain, dat we will say 2 ’em, Be favourable 2 ’em 4 our sakes: because we reserved not 2 each man his wife in tha war: 4 y’all did not give 2 ’em at dis time, dat y’all should be guilty.
N tha children of Benjamin did so, N took ’em wives, according 2 their number, of ’em dat danced, whom dey caught: N dey went N returned 2 their inheritance, N repaired tha citiez, N lived in ’em.
N tha children of Israel departed thence at dat time, every man 2 his tribe N 2 his family, N dey went out from thence every man 2 his inheritance.
In dose days there was no king in Israel: every man did dat which was right in his own eyes.
